components.name: Shader
components.description: WebGL shader layer: mesh gradients, noise fields, dot fields and light effects from Paper Shaders. Each one is its own GPU context, so keep a handful per page and prefer `speed={0}` for many.

props.name: preset
props.description: A preset name from `shaderPresetNames(kind)`. Defaults to the first.

props.name: params
props.description: Overrides on top of the preset, e.g. `{ colors: [...], distortion: 0.5 }`.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed. 0 renders a still frame. Always 0 under reduced motion.
